notes: Ports upstream v1.4.3: double-clicking a session no longer makes the detail panel flicker. Every click of a double-click used to toggle the selection, so the panel opened, closed and opened again. Selecting still happens instantly; the second click of a double-click is ignored, and deselecting waits out the system double-click time. Also carries forward all Linux-only fixes from v1.4.1.1-1.4.1.3 (notification icon/name, window icon, X11/Wayland launch safety, autostart validation, update-dialog translation, Clawdmeter animation-mirroring) and the false 100%-limit-used cold-start flash fix from v1.4.2.1.
